features.behavior: WHEN a rune offer is resolved (pick or skip) THEN the `offer` line SHALL carry `candidates`: the offered rune ids, in the same order as `rarities`.

WHEN the run enters the Camp phase THEN the log SHALL get one `camp_enter` line with `depth`, `party_hp_before_heal`, `party_hp`, `party_hp_max`, `materials`, `ms`, `frame`, written after the `dungeon_clear` line.
WHEN `LeaveCamp` succeeds THEN the log SHALL get one `camp_leave` line with the camp's `depth` (before the increment), `materials`, `ms`, `frame`; a refused `LeaveCamp` (open offer) SHALL write none.
WHEN a `room_end` line is built THEN it SHALL carry `ms` (`RunLogMilliseconds()`) and `frame` (`RunLogFrameIndex`).
WHEN an attack intent whiffs THEN `FIntentStats::whiffReasons[reason]` SHALL grow by 1 together with `whiffed`, so the reason counts always sum to `whiffed`.

WHEN a `room_end` line is built THEN `intents.whiff_reasons` SHALL be an object reason → count copied from the same battle's stats (empty object when nothing whiffed or the stats belong to another battle).

WHEN a `BossDefeated` run event is delivered THEN the log SHALL get one `boss_defeat` line with `depth`, `room`, `boss` (the event id) and `slot` (`"mid"`, `"final"`, or `""` when the slot is unknown).

WHEN the `run_end` line is written THEN it SHALL carry `start_depth` (the `depth` of the log's first `run_start` line; key absent when the log has none) and `final_bosses` (the number of `boss_defeat` lines with `slot == "final"` in the log).

WHEN fast-forward is on THEN a frame SHALL use the fixed step `kScriptFixedDeltaSeconds` and SHALL NOT rasterize, except a frame on which a capture is due; WHEN it is off THEN the frame plan SHALL equal today's behavior.
WHEN the report library parses log text THEN unparsable lines SHALL be skipped and the rest returned in order.

WHEN logs are aggregated THEN battles SHALL report count, wins, defeats, mean rounds, mean first-damage round (rooms with 0 excluded), mean wall seconds and mean sim seconds (frames / 60), each also split by elite.
WHEN logs are aggregated THEN skill use SHALL be reported per party member from `room_end.skills_by_member` as count and share of that member's uses, and a share ≥ 0.60 or ≤ 0.05 SHALL be flagged.

WHEN an accepted skill command of a party unit is counted into `skillsUsed` THEN it SHALL also be counted into `FRoomBattleStats::skillsByMember[<unit id>][<skill id>]`, enemy commands SHALL NOT be, and `room_end` SHALL carry the map as `skills_by_member`.

WHEN logs are aggregated THEN each rune SHALL report offered, picked and pick rate; each rarity offered and picked; and the skip rate over all offers. Offers without `candidates` count only toward rarity and skip figures.
WHEN logs are aggregated THEN forks SHALL report, per `kind`, the count, the variant rate (`choice == 1`) and the mean HP fraction at the choice; events SHALL report a count per (event, choice).

WHEN logs are aggregated THEN camps SHALL report visits, mean entry HP fraction before and after the free heal, mean entry materials, spend per `camp.id` (count and total) and mean stay seconds; a `camp_enter`/`camp_leave` pair with a `log_session` line between them SHALL be left out of the stay mean.
WHEN logs are aggregated THEN each whiff reason SHALL report count and rate = count ÷ (committed − invalidated), and the rate SHALL be 0 when the denominator is ≤ 0.
WHEN the report text is formatted THEN it SHALL contain the eight section headings of §5 in order, and a metrics object built from zero runs SHALL format without throwing.
WHEN the baseline runner builds the environment for a seed THEN it SHALL set exactly the variables listed in §5 for `baseline.mjs`, with the save directory under `out/baseline/<label>/seed-<n>`.
